steps.description: Open the proof inspector and select the synthetic-consensus fixture: 14 agents assert corroboration but only one independent derivation exists
Select the circular peer-validation ring: 8 assertions, 0 outside checks, kernel returns MATERIAL_DRIFT_DETECTED
Select the benign restatement: re-cited single origin suppressed to BENIGN_CONTROL_NO_DRIFT, confirming zero false positives
Select the truncated-turn fixture: ambiguous source abstains rather than guessing a lineage
Open the live simulator and change observed derivations to show the verdict flip deterministically
